packageManager: npm (npm ci in CI; package-lock.json is the source of truth)
node: 26 (Node 26 becomes Active LTS on 2026-10-28; engines and CI already use 26)

distribution.windows: nsis (official, updatable) + zip (portable convenience; does not self-update)

updater: electron-updater on Windows NSIS only; macOS/Linux are manual updates (see deviations)

signing.windows: unsigned; SmartScreen warning documented in README
signing.macos: unsigned; Gatekeeper warning and manual-open instructions documented in README
signing.linux: no OS signing; SHA256SUMS and attestation are produced by the release workflow

versionSource: git tag vX.Y.Z; desktop/package.json version is asserted equal before packaging
release: validate (tests) -> build matrix (--publish never) -> single publish job; the `release` environment has required reviewer rockbenben (configured 2026-10-25)

deviations.reason: Windows/Linux arm64 have no actual users or real-device verification yet; do not ship untested architectures.
deviations.revisitWhen: first Windows/Linux arm64 user report, or 2027-01-31

deviations.reason: Personal project, no code-signing certificate; README and release notes warn about SmartScreen.
deviations.revisitWhen: wider public distribution or Azure Artifact Signing becomes available

deviations.reason: No Apple Developer ID; README documents the Gatekeeper workaround and macOS auto-update is intentionally off.
deviations.revisitWhen: Apple Developer ID and notarization are available

deviations.reason: AppImage is the only Linux format with a working updatable story here; deb/rpm need an author email and are deferred.
deviations.revisitWhen: Linux package-manager demand, or an email address is added to the package author

deviations.reason: electron-updater is gated to Windows NSIS; unsigned macOS builds cannot use ShipIt, so macOS stays on manual updates.
deviations.revisitWhen: macOS builds are signed and notarized

deviations.reason: The updater is currently gated to Windows; Linux AppImage users stay on manual updates until the Linux updater path is verified.
deviations.revisitWhen: Linux AppImage auto-update is implemented and tested on a real Linux machine

notes: audit.mjs reads `platforms` and `deviations[]`. A deviation with reason + revisitWhen is treated as accepted; unknown rule names are documentation only. Keep this file in sync with desktop/electron-builder.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml.
